intro: Each martial art has its own clothes and its own name. Judo students wear a thick cotton jacket. School wrestlers wear a one-piece singlet. Sumo wrestlers wear a heavy cloth belt.
In this unit, you will learn what a belt color means. You will meet ranks with names like dan and kyu. You will also learn where names like karate, taekwondo and kung fu come from.
By the end, you can tell what a school mark shows. You can match an art to its land and its language. You can name a real date for a rank or a uniform.
bigQuestion: What do a uniform, a belt and a name tell us about where a martial art comes from?

timeline.t: Japan takes over the Ryukyu Kingdom on Okinawa
Kanō Jigorō opens the Kodokan judo school in Tokyo
Kanō gives the first dan ranks in judo
Fencing and wrestling are in the first modern Olympics
Karate classes in Tokyo begin wearing white suits like judo's
The word karate is written a new way, meaning empty hand
Olympic épée fencing uses an electric scoring box
Illinois crowns its first boys state wrestling champions
The name taekwondo is chosen in Korea
Taekwondo becomes an Olympic medal sport in Sydney
A Philippine law names arnis the national martial art
Illinois holds its first girls state wrestling finals

a grade for students who are still learning, before the dan ranks

the thick cloth belt that sumo wrestlers wear
a martial art and sport from Korea

test.why: The IHSA held the first girls state finals in 2022.

write.prompt: Pick two arts from this unit, like judo and taekwondo. Tell where each one comes from. Tell what its name means or what its students wear. Use one real date from the unit, like 1883 for dan ranks or 2022 for Illinois girls wrestling.
